description: This file defines custom error types for the Mattermost server, including errors for invalid input, limits exceeded, conflicts, not found, out of bounds, not implemented, and unique constraints.

classes.name: ErrInvalidInput
classes.description: Represents an error due to invalid input, with methods for error message, wrapping errors, and retrieving info.

classes.name: ErrLimitExceeded
classes.description: Represents an error when a limit is exceeded.

classes.name: ErrConflict
classes.description: Represents a conflict error with resource, internal error, and metadata.

classes.name: ErrNotFound
classes.description: Represents a resource not found error, with methods for error message, wrapping, and type assertion.

classes.name: ErrOutOfBounds
classes.description: Represents an error when a requested limit exceeds allowed bounds.

classes.name: ErrNotImplemented
classes.description: Represents an unimplemented feature or requirement.

classes.name: ErrUniqueConstraint
classes.description: Represents a uniqueness constraint violation, with columns involved.

methods.name: ErrInvalidInput.Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for ErrInvalidInput.

methods.name: ErrInvalidInput.Wrap
methods.description: Wraps an existing error inside ErrInvalidInput.

methods.name: ErrInvalidInput.InvalidInputInfo
methods.description: Returns entity, field, and value info.

methods.name: ErrLimitExceeded.Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for ErrLimitExceeded.

methods.name: ErrConflict.Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for ErrConflict.

methods.name: ErrNotFound.Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for ErrNotFound.

methods.name: ErrOutOfBounds.Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for ErrOutOfBounds.

methods.name: ErrNotImplemented.Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for ErrNotImplemented.

methods.name: ErrUniqueConstraint.Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for ErrUniqueConstraint.
